subject.title: Prefer chat names in agent session labels

question: Should descriptive guardian and subagent session rows show the originating chat title first and task context second for users who enabled descriptive labels?
rationale: This is a deliberate user-visible ordering change within an existing configurable feature; tests establish the implementation but cannot establish the preferred information hierarchy.

options.title: Adopt chat-first labels
options.body: Accept the chat title as the primary label and retain guardian or subagent task context after the separator, subject to redacted live proof.

options.title: Keep task-first labels
options.body: Preserve the ordering shipped by the related feature and close this refinement unless a broader label-policy redesign is desired.

recommendation.title: Adopt chat-first labels
recommendation.body: Accept the chat title as the primary label and retain guardian or subagent task context after the separator, subject to redacted live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged descriptive-label implementation and have the strongest available feature-history connection.
